start_stop_persist.statement: start <project> stores an active session and stop closes it with an end time; both are persisted in the JSON file and survive a new process.

start_refused_when_active.statement: start while a session is active exits non-zero, names the active project, and leaves the file unchanged.
must_include: refuse start while a session is active

overlap_detected.statement: log flags sessions whose intervals intersect with positive length and does not flag touching ones.

duration_format.statement: Durations render as zero-padded HH:MM:SS, with hours beyond 99 and 24 shown unwrapped (e.g. 100:00:01).

report_totals.statement: report prints one line per project with the sum of its session durations as HH:MM:SS, including the active session up to now.

error_exits.statement: stop with no active session and an unreadable or corrupt JSON file exit non-zero with a message on stderr and never overwrite the corrupt file.

single_file_stdlib.statement: time_tracker.py imports only standard library modules and is the only module the tests need.
